svg.title: Fig. 5 Local paired-error changes and boundary effects
svg.desc: Panels show positive paired-error frequency, conditional positive-tail median and P95, and boundary speed mismatch, boundary acceleration mismatch, and endpoint shift. Fixed SG denotes SG(5,2). Raw endpoint shift is zero by definition and is not plotted. Connecting median-to-P95 strokes are descriptive guides, not uncertainty intervals. Continuous numeric axes include small positive-direction arrowheads; categorical axes do not. Panel (c) units are shown in parentheses beneath each subplot title.
